votes.Vote: H2, with the leader line amended to '+C$15,659 in pretend money'
votes.Reason: It keeps the hook (money is the clear, simple score) while the word 'pretend' sits in the headline itself, so the first impression cannot be that real money is being made; 'best judgment' is vaguer and asks the reader to trust a claim we can't measure apart from the money.
votes.Risk: Slightly clunkier; a reader skimming only the crown line could still read it as real profit, hence 'pretend money' there too.
votes.Leader line: Yes, on its own it can read as real profit; add 'pretend money'.
